items.title: Tony Fougerat Interview, 1960-06-08
items.q: I've played with musicians like Leonard Beisdorf. It's Johnny Beisdorf's brother.

ctx.x: Okay, Paul? Paul Crawford. He's running the machine, and I'm Dick Allen. Okay, we've got everybody identified now for the secretary. Tony, first thing I'd like to know is, when were you born and where?

Well, I was born in New Orleans in 1900, April 25th. And I started my... Funny thing about music, never even had music in my brain. I always wanted to be a locomotive engineer. When I was a kid, I always fooled around engines. And I went along, and here comes around the year 1918. Instead of winding up getting a job in the railroad, I wind up being a musician. In fact, it was just born on me. I never took a lesson. I just bought a horn on Ramport Street. I never will forget that. It was a tin horn. I don't…
What kind of piano player was Lobosky?
